dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, have you ever eaten insects?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈiːtən ˈɪnsɛkts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I haven't! Have you, Mr. Brown?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈhævənt! ˈhæv juː, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. I tried them at a market in Chiang Mai.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. aɪ ˈtraɪd ðɛm ət ə ˈmɑːrkɪt ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not bad! I've eaten a lot of street food in Thailand.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈbæd! aɪv ˈiːtən ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈstriːt ˌfuːd ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Khao soi. I've flown to Chiang Mai three times, and I had it every time.
dialogue.reading: ˌkaʊ ˈsɔɪ. aɪv ˈfloʊn tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz, ənd aɪ ˈhæd ɪt ˈɛvri ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. Once was enough!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. ˈwʌns wʌz ɪˈnʌf!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A lot of people say that!
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ðæt!
